I kinda messed up when uploading but this gallery is indeed English translated. Sorry, but I'm still getting used to uploading stuff here.
_____
AI-generated translation still sucks right now because it breaks the immersion. The sentencing is off most of the time as they get translated literally and fixing that using context clues is too expensive. They also make a mess out of the images when they clean, so that sucks too.

I took a few liberties when it comes to making the text flow better. Mandarin has many complex sentence structures that make it impossible to transliterate without sounding off to native English speakers. There are bound to be mistakes, as I didn't really have the time nor energy to proofread more than once. However, I'll update the images if issues are brought up to my attention (or when I revisit). Feel free drop a message by my inbox in that case.

To other translators, feel free to pick up or even improve this chapter's translation if you think this series is interesting. There's really a lack of English-translated Mandarin 3D works around, even though most of them probably take a lot of effort to make. This release is just to show a little love for them, that even non-Chinese audience might enjoy these kinds of work. Just maybe post a comment under this thread so that other translators don't clash with your work.

To the others, please support the original creator if you can, so that we can enjoy the story to its end.
